verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes an auto-generated OpenAPI document whose info.version follows the product release. That is a release label, not versioned API endpoints. Nothing in the evidence describes API version guarantees or a deprecation policy for the RPC, plugin, or MCP APIs. missing for 10: explicitly versioned API endpoints or contracts, a documented deprecation policy with timelines, changelog or migration guidance for API changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
